candidate: H55a position-conditioned block-32 K32 product code

parent_evidence.causal_transition: H54 uses three choices for an entire 768-coordinate row, learns only 0.327 capture points beyond its initialization, and does not collapse its dictionary. Move nearly every compact bit into independent 32-coordinate subrow choices and test the generic rate-distortion limit directly.

scientific_question: Can a globally shared, position-conditioned block-32 K32 product code exploit enough within-row structure in the six-node top-16 MLP tangent to exceed its 19.48 percent near-Haar rate-distortion reference and pass the frozen representation gates under one percent checkpoint bytes?

frozen_inventory.pca_centering: independent mean of all 239 states for the optimistic capacity ceiling
frozen_inventory.reported_weighting: eigenvalue normalized within each node top-16 set

frozen_decoder.seed_weight: exact step-zero matrix, reproducible from matched initialization and not charged as learned state
frozen_decoder.dictionary_storage: one globally shared position-conditioned symmetric signed-int4 codebook with one FP16 scale per codeword
frozen_decoder.private_state: one packed hard five-bit code for every deployed node, row, and block position

rate_distortion_reference.interpretation: This is a generic isotropic rate reference, not a theorem about the empirical source. Capture materially above it demonstrates exploitable block-local structure; capture near it but below the frozen gate means same-rate transform engineering is insufficient.

unquantized_capacity_fit.purpose: necessary optimistic FP32 product-code capacity gate; not a deployable checkpoint
unquantized_capacity_fit.dictionary_initialization: for each of 24 block positions, choose 32 distinct raw target blocks by a deterministic seed, stratified uniformly over all node-PC targets and energy-weighted within each target
unquantized_capacity_fit.block_sampling: each update samples node-PC targets uniformly, block positions uniformly, and rows proportional to squared block norm
unquantized_capacity_fit.optimizer: minibatch Lloyd assignment and per-codeword weighted mean update with frozen EMA coefficient 0.25
unquantized_capacity_fit.assignment: hard nearest squared Euclidean codeword within the matching block position; no soft logits
unquantized_capacity_fit.training_objective: mean squared block reconstruction error under target-balanced energy-weighted sampling
unquantized_capacity_fit.evaluation: reconstruct all 24 blocks of every row of all 96 full PCs with hard codes, then report full-matrix squared-cosine capture

controls.fixed_initial_codebook: the exact deterministic position-conditioned initialization without learned updates
controls.global_unpositioned_codebook: one learned K32 codebook shared across all 24 block positions under the same five-bit private rate
controls.fixed_random_codebook: deterministic Gaussian K32 codebook per position with hard assignments
controls.equal_rate_scalar_sign: one of 32 learned signed scalar levels multiplying a fixed deterministic sign carrier per block position
controls.position_strata: capture for each of the 24 column-block positions
controls.utilization: per-position active fraction, entropy, and maximum code load
controls.synthetic_own_family: known product-code targets must reconstruct at least 99.9 percent

quantized_stage_if_and_only_if_unquantiz.quantizer: symmetric per-codeword signed int4 with codes in [-7,7] and one FP16 scale
quantized_stage_if_and_only_if_unquantiz.reassignment: rerun hard product-code assignment after quantization
quantized_stage_if_and_only_if_unquantiz.packing: pack the exact five-bit code stream without byte padding per logical code
quantized_stage_if_and_only_if_unquantiz.required_metrics: all capacity gates plus quantization loss, exact packing, chronology, late updates, A/B common path and heldout innovation

systems_accounting.materialization: one packed-code lookup and scaled 32-value copy per block
systems_accounting.training_state_rule: FP32 codebook masters, assignment workspace, sampled targets, gradients or EMA statistics are reported separately and are not checkpoint state; soft logits and dense shadows are forbidden persistent state

promotion: Only a complete unquantized and int4 capacity pass authorizes chronological-late and A/B-stream representation audits. No stage directly authorizes function fitting, CE, attention, or scale-up.
failure: Close this exact block-32 K32 position-conditioned product code without block-size, codebook-size, bit-rate, role-split, coefficient, sampling, optimizer, step, seed, CE, or model-size sweep.
forbidden: calling the unquantized product code a compact checkpoint
persistent empirical PCs, per-node bases, dense masters, dense residuals, private FP16 coefficients, or soft assignment logits
excluding codebook bits, scales, packed codes, FP32 training masters, assignment workspace, or EMA statistics from the relevant accounting
block-size, codebook-size, bit-rate, role-split, coefficient, sample, optimizer, step, seed, threshold, layer, or role sweep
function, CE, attention, or model-size experiments before every representation gate passes
